websites.title: Websites or domains
websites.description: Array of strings, e.g. ["stripe.com","https://www.hubspot.com"]. Domains or URLs; one row per company. Required unless you pass datasetId. Sites that fail get a free row with status and error instead of being dropped.

datasetId.title: Or: dataset ID from another Actor
datasetId.description: Optional. Enrich the websites in another run's dataset, e.g. Google Maps, job or lead scraper results. Example: "aBcD1234efGH5678". Duplicates are removed. In an integration (run this after another Actor finishes) use {{resource.defaultDatasetId}}.

websiteField.title: Website field in that dataset
websiteField.description: Field holding the URL or domain, e.g. "website" (dot paths like "company.url" work). Leave empty to auto-detect: website, websiteUrl, companyWebsite, companyUrl, companyDomain, domain, homepage, url, loc.

datasetMaxItems.title: Max websites from the dataset
datasetMaxItems.description: Read at most this many websites from the dataset (default 1000), to keep costs predictable.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max pages per website
maxPagesPerSite.description: Homepage plus contact, about, imprint and careers pages. More pages find more contacts; 4 is a good balance.

includeTechStack.title: Detect tech stack
includeTechStack.description: Detect 130+ technologies (CMS, ecommerce, analytics, marketing automation, ad pixels, chat, frameworks, CDN, payments, consent).

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel websites
maxConcurrency.description: How many websites to process at the same time.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Seconds to wait for each page before giving up (default 20). Raise it for slow sites.

maxRetries.title: Retries per page
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a failed page request (default 1).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Not needed for most sites. Enable Apify Proxy only if many sites return HTTP 403 (bot protection).
